input:
we’re still wrestling with how claim progress messages go out — it’s all manual right now and we’re behind on updates
Claim progress notifications are sent manually, causing delays.

That’s a welcome update — we’ve been needing better task tracking.
The customer lacks adequate task tracking in the platform.

policyholder reported the same incident both over the phone and through the web portal, and it created two separate claims without any alert.
Duplicate claims are created when the same incident is reported via phone and the web portal, and the system provides no alert.

Also, every time we upload a garage estimate, it lands in correspondence — it’s a wrong document category and handlers keep missing key evidence because of it.
Garage estimate documents are automatically placed in the wrong category, causing handlers to miss key evidence.

Uploaded documents are sometimes misfiled — garage estimates get dumped into correspondence, forcing handlers to manually reassign them, and that’s where evidence can slip through the cracks because of ... file type assignment.
Uploaded documents are sometimes misfiled into the wrong category, requiring manual correction.

handlers are wasting time fixing incorrect file type assignments, and it’s impacting claim accuracy
Handlers spend time correcting wrong file type assignments, reducing claim accuracy.

we had to retrain three people just to find the new location, and someone even submitted a payment in error because the button moved... unexpected interface changes moved key controls without warning — it’s causing real errors in claims and payments.
Unexpected interface changes move key controls without warning, causing errors and requiring staff retraining.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal because I can’t access my account right now.
The user cannot log into the claims portal because they need to reset their password.

We’ve already reprocessed the documents twice but the reserves still aren’t updating in the reporting tab.
Reserves are not updating in the reporting tab despite reprocessing documents.

Also, when we’re uploading evidence for a claim, it’s tedious to add each file one at a time... we really need the ability to use multiple file upload to batch‑add documents to a claim.
Users must upload claim evidence files one at a time, which is time‑consuming.

We’ve seen the same loss reported through two channels — phone and web — and no system warning appeared, creating a duplicate loss report that complicates our reserves and payments.
The system does not warn when the same loss is reported through multiple channels, resulting in duplicate loss reports.

Just that we’re losing time daily on this — it’s not sustainable without better visibility and planning.
The user lacks sufficient visibility and planning tools, causing daily time loss.

Claim details: click "Save", rage x3
Saving claim details is causing repeated rage, indicating the save action is broken or frustrating.

when a policyholder reports a loss both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t flag it as a potential duplicate. We end up with two separate claims for the same event, which complicates reserves and payments.
The system fails to detect duplicate loss reports submitted via phone and the web portal, creating separate claims for the same event.

I’m having trouble accessing the claims module — it’s saying my login credentials aren’t valid.
The user cannot log into the claims module because the system says the credentials are invalid.

Claims: click "Next" ... Claims: click "Overview", dead x1
The Overview button in the Claims flow is broken and does not load.

our finance team’s noticed the report totals differ — they’re comparing dashboard numbers with exported files and getting confused.
Report totals shown on the dashboard do not match the numbers in exported files, causing confusion.

We’ve got a lot of policyholder files to attach to claims, so we’re hoping there’s a way to handle multiple file upload efficiently. We’ve got a number of claims files to attach and really need the multiple file upload capability to save time — it’s a bit of a bottleneck doing them one by one right now.
Customers cannot upload multiple claim files at once, forcing a slow, one‑by‑one process.

Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual control for complex cases — it’s a team-level thing.
The system cannot automatically route claims by postcode while allowing manual control for complex cases.

Also, we’ve had a duplicate loss report issue — same incident logged twice, no alert triggered at intake.
Duplicate loss reports are created and no alert is triggered at intake.

we’re spending too much time calling garages because we can’t see live repair updates — it’s a daily grind
Users cannot view live repair updates, so they have to call garages repeatedly.

We need predictability so our staff don’t have to keep relearning where things are.
The platform’s layout is inconsistent, forcing staff to repeatedly relearn where features are located.

I’m having trouble logging into Keelwater to upload the policyholder documents for our latest claim.
The user cannot log in to Keelwater, preventing them from uploading claim documents.

Tasks: click "Save", rage x3
Saving a claim fails repeatedly, causing frustration.

we need to ensure reserves reflect real-time changes without manual overrides
Reserves do not update automatically in real time, requiring manual overrides.

we’re having trouble pulling the latest payments report for our policyholders
The user cannot pull the latest payments report.

Great — we’ll be ready to go live once the upload files together issue is resolved.
The upload‑files‑together feature is broken, preventing the customer from going live.

our commercial claims team needs manual claim routing — auto-assignment breaks our complex cases.
The commercial claims team cannot use auto-assignment for complex cases and requires manual claim routing.

we’re having trouble accessing our reserves dashboard after the update last week.
Customers cannot access the reserves dashboard after the recent update.

It’s messy when the same claim twice comes in — one by phone, one online, and the system doesn’t flag it.
The system fails to flag duplicate claims that arrive via different channels.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal as I’m locked out and can’t access documents or reserves.
The user is locked out of the claims portal because they cannot reset their password.

We need letters in Welsh for policyholders — it’s not just a nice-to-have, it’s tied to our renewal terms with Keelwater.
The platform does not support generating letters in Welsh for policyholders.

We’ve got a few questions about how claims get assigned to our teams.
The customer is unclear about how claims are assigned to their teams.

We’re still wrestling with how claim progress messages go out — it’s all manual right now and we’re behind on updates, so we’re relying on manual workarounds until automation lands.
Claim progress notifications are sent manually, causing delays and extra work.

Claims: click "Link to existing claim", dead x1
The 'Link to existing claim' button does not work.

any update on when policyholders will start getting those milestone updates automatically?
Milestone updates are not being sent automatically to policyholders yet.

How do I upload policyholder documents into the system without triggering a reserve alert?
Uploading policyholder documents triggers a reserve alert, blocking the upload.

need clarity on how your system manages reserves and supplier payments together
The customer is unclear about how the system handles reserves and supplier payments together.

We’re seeing cases where the same claim twice appears because the system doesn’t alert staff when a matching incident already exists in intake — we’ve had to manually link them after the fact, which delays payments and reporting.
The system fails to warn staff about duplicate claims during intake, requiring manual linking and causing delays.

we’ve got policyholders waiting on letters, and tasks are piling up because the reporting module’s stuck
The reporting module is stuck, causing delays in sending letters to policyholders.

The lack of real-time visibility into garage progress is forcing us to chase manually — garage progress visibility is a blocker we need solved ASAP.
Customers cannot see garage progress in real time, forcing manual follow‑up and causing delays.

Could that have broken the reporting flow?
Updating the supplier list may have broken the reporting flow.

garage estimates keep landing in Correspondence, and our handlers have to manually move them, which risks missing critical evidence
Garage estimate documents are automatically categorized as Correspondence, forcing handlers to manually reclassify them and risking missed evidence.

we’re setting up our team workflows and need clarity on how claim allocation works across different lines
The user is unclear about how claim allocation works across different lines when setting up team workflows.

when evidence gets misfiled, it can slip through the cracks... Every time a garage estimate gets dumped into correspondence, someone has to manually fix it — and sometimes the wrong document category means evidence gets overlooked entirely.
Garage estimate evidence is being misfiled into the wrong document category, requiring manual correction.

I’m trying to upload a claim document but the system says I’ve selected the wrong document category — can you help?
The user cannot upload a claim document because the system says the selected document category is wrong.

I think we need a clearer way to manage reserves and supplier payments.
The platform lacks a clear way to manage reserves and supplier payments.

our policyholders keep asking why they don’t get automatic updates when their claim moves to the next stage... we’ve had multiple policyholders ask why they aren’t getting automatic alerts when their claim status changes — customer milestone messaging would solve this.
Policyholders are not receiving automatic alerts when their claim status changes.

we can pull full audit logs for admin review — it’s becoming urgent for our compliance team... we really need the audit-log export for admins to meet our internal compliance deadlines
Admins cannot export full audit logs for compliance review.

We’re running into delays because reserve adjustments above our team’s limit just sit there until the one approver comes back — no backup, no delegation, and claims pile up.
Approvals for reserve adjustments above the team limit cannot be delegated, causing delays and claim backlogs.

click "Link to existing claim", dead x1
The "Link to existing claim" button does not work.

When a handler needs to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it goes into an approval waiting list — but if the approver’s out, nothing moves until they return.
Adjusting a reserve gets stuck in the approval queue when the assigned approver is unavailable.

when assigning staff to different claim roles, we can’t seem to map our existing sign-on groups to those roles directly... that mapping isn’t available, and it’s causing extra manual work for our team.
Customers cannot map their existing sign‑on groups to claim roles in Keelwater, forcing extra manual work.

That’d be great — also, is there a way to lock reporting periods so payments don’t get double-counted?
Customers cannot lock reporting periods, leading to risk of double‑counted payments.

the filters vanish after I log out
Saved filters disappear after the user logs out.

We’ve had some trouble recently with attaching multiple files to claims — it’s been clunky.
Attaching multiple files to a claim is clunky and difficult.

the error message makes it sound like a bug
The error message suggests a bug in Keelwater even though the issue is a customer network failure.

I need to reset my password for the Keelwater portal because I can’t access my account to upload claims documents.
The user cannot log in because they need to reset their password.

And the unexpected interface changes — last week the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning, and we had to retrain our team mid-week.
The Claims Tasks panel disappeared unexpectedly because of unannounced interface changes.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — it’s not letting me ... even though I’m sure I’m typing it right.
The user cannot log into the claims portal because password reset is not working.

we’re getting blocked trying to log into Keelwater again this morning. It’s showing ‘down’ but I think it’s on our end.
Users are unable to log into Keilwater because the service appears down.

we’re manually sending claim progress messages, but it’s time‑consuming and inconsistent... manually drafting and sending claim progress messages to keep policyholders informed, but it’s inefficient and error‑prone.
Manual claim progress messaging is time‑consuming, inconsistent, and error‑prone.

I know the official way to upload files together isn’t live yet, ... it’ll get you through until the feature ships on 6 October.
Users cannot upload multiple files at once; they must add files individually.

We’re getting pressure from our policyholders in Wales — they need official correspondence in their own language. Specifically, we need Welsh letter formats for claims and payments.
The platform does not provide Welsh language letter templates for claims and payments.
